feedback: Reject: the graph makes damping, waterAddedMass, and thrusterNaturalFrequency unconditionally mandatory on every ship, although the requirement is conditional on a natural-frequency estimation case. The hasNaturalFrequencyCalculationCase link is currently optional, so its nested direction constraint can be bypassed; it must be constrained consistently with the conditional applicability design.
